release_notes: Build 104 moves website SEO into its own administration page directly under Comments.
The SEO page audits every website quiz in one pass instead of checking only the selected quiz.
The audit summary shows total quizzes, ready metadata, warnings and structural issues that need attention.
Every quiz is classified as Automatic or Custom SEO so generated defaults are not treated as missing metadata.
The audit flags duplicate SEO titles, duplicate visible quiz titles, duplicate or invalid slugs, missing required metadata and search/social copy that falls outside recommended lengths.
Rows needing attention are sorted ahead of warnings and ready quizzes so the most important fixes are visible first.
Double-click a quiz or use Edit selected to open the existing search and social preview editor, save the change and immediately rerun the whole-catalogue audit.
The old Website catalogue Edit SEO button is suppressed so SEO management has one clear home under Comments.
Build 103 grouped physical-folder archive fixes remain included unchanged.
No website quiz scoring, publishing schedule, visibility, account or analytics behavior is changed.
